text:
marta: FYI ran into a nasty client-side stall in the new onboarding sample when prefetch=3 + token-rotation feed. Streams started queuing and throughput tanked. Repro on staging.

owen: Can you share quick steps?

marta: Steps: set sample.config.prefetch=3, enable connector_cache, run `wrk -t4 -c60` against /chat/stream for 60s. After ~20s queued climbs and workers freeze.

li: Any logs?

marta: Snip: ```
WARN client: queued=120 inflight=4 leases_in_use=0
ERROR client: lease_wait_timeout lease_id=lk_92 held_by=retry-path
```

ops-jules: Interesting: leases_in_use=0 but inflight non-zero implies permits held somewhere else (cache connector or retry path).

owen: This sounds related to cursor churn + prefetch racing. If prefetch creates background fetches for old cursors, retries + auth refresh could block permit lifecycle.

marta: Agreed. I prototyped a mitigation: instead of spawning prefetch tasks immediately, push prefetch jobs into a small "quarantine" queue with ttl=500ms. When the async worker picks it up it validates `cursor.current == job.cursor` before executing. That cut duplicate/held leases in half in staging.

li: Nice. That avoids locking the main permit pool while prefetches might be invalid. Any downsides?

marta: Slight latency for warm prefetch (up to 500ms). We made the ttl configurable and default=0 for backwards parity.

ops-jules: Can we also add a fast-path: if prefetch_spawn sees token unexplainedly changed, drop spawn immediately (no quarantine). Quarantine is for race windows where token may stable soon.

owen: Telemetry suggestions: `prefetch_quarantine_dropped`, `prefetch_quarantine_executed`, `prefetch_mismatch_dropped`. Also a gauge `quarantine_queue_len`.

marta: I pushed a small PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/2112 1 adds quarantine queue + ttl option + metrics. Unit tests included for cursor mismatch.

devex-bot: Issue created: #5255-prefetch-quarantine-mitigation (assigned to li) https://issues.redwood.ai/5255

li: I'll take the follow-up: 1) add SDK-parity implementation in rust/go clients, 2) add integration canary in staging with quarantine ttl=200ms, prefetch=2, monitor `permits_held_ms` histogram.

owen: Also we should document the tradeoff in devex: "Quarantine mitigates duplicate fetches and lease hold risks at the cost of small prefetch delay. Enable for feeds that rotate cursors frequently."

marta: Will update sampleapp README and add a snippet in onboarding docs with recommended settings: prefetch=1-2 + quarantine_ttl=100-300ms for high-churn feeds.

ops-jules: For canary, set connector_cache.ttl=30s to avoid long-lived connector state interfering. Abort if `permits_held_ms` p50 > 200ms for 5m.

li: ETA: PR for rust parity + canary config by tomorrow EOD. I'll link smoke test results here.

marta: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

owen: Great work catching this before it hits a customer lane.
